title: Chen Wu (Investiture of the Gods)
extracted_sentences: Chen Wu () is a character in the classical Chinese fantasy novel Fengshen Yanyi .
Chen Wu is the commander of Through-Clouds-Pass and the elder brother of Chen Tong.
When Chen Tong died, smoke signals were immediately sent from High-Water-Pass and were visible at Chen Wu's location.
Upon learning about his brother's demise, Chen Wu becomes aware that Huang Feihu will soon arrive at his pass.
Realizing that it would be more effective to use cunning rather than sheer strength, Chen Wu decides to employ a strategic approach to eliminate Huang Feihu.
When Huang Feihu and his followers eventually reach Chen Wu's garrison compound, Chen Wu extends a calm invitation, inviting them to partake in food and rest.
In a short span of time, Huang Feihu and his men are treated to an abundance of wine and food, thoroughly enjoying their stay.
During the night, Huang Feihu receives a message from his deceased wife, warning him that he has fallen into Chen Wu's trap.
Swiftly, before the fire surrounding their sleeping quarters can be set ablaze, Huang Feihu swiftly cuts through the walls and manages to escape with his entourage.
Chen Wu pursues them hastily, but he is ultimately defeated by Huang Feihu's exceptional skills in combat.
Chen Wu was appointed as the deity of Yuexing Star (Yue Xing Xing ) in the end Fengshen Yanyi Chapter 99..
